description_en: Uninstalls applications from one or more Cloud Phone instances
description_zh: 批量从无影云手机实例中卸载应用
kebab_example: aliyun eds-aic uninstall-app --app-id-list 12345 --instance-group-id-list ag-ferag1vraw0000 --instance-id-list acp-3eourrxapshn20000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UninstallApp

parameters.help_en: A list of instance group IDs. You must specify either this parameter or `InstanceIdList`. If you specify both, only `InstanceGroupIdList` takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
实例组ID列表。
该参数与InstanceIdList参数选填一个。如果两者同时有值，则仅InstanceGroupIdList有效

parameters.help_zh:
